During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this '''IG-86 sentinel droid''' was owned by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]].

==Biography==
===Dangerous cargo===
{{Quote|Go yourself, but be careful, there are many, um, ''unique'' items down here.|Gha Nachkt|<ref name="DoD" />}}
An [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] was created by [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]]<ref name="TCWCG" /> to serve as [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was obtained by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]],<ref name="DoD" /> who was constantly scouring abandoned space battle zones for any material, from scraps to droids he could salvage and sell.<ref name="Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961d625bdc011d72dcb9ad0019|text=Dataclip: Downfall of a Droid|na=video file}}</ref> Nachkt stored the droid with [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid 2/Legends|another sentinel droid]] he had found to a cargo hold of his<ref name="DoD" /> [[GS-100 salvage ship/Legends|GS-100 salvage ship]],<ref name="TCWCG" /> the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']].<ref name="DoDEP">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode006.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> As the IG-86 sentinel droids were known to be higly unpredictable, the pair could have posed a threat to the Trandoshan's life. As such, Nachkt kept the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] droids deactivated, although they were linked to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] by electronic wires, so they could be manually activated at any time.<ref name="DoD" /><ref name="RSAD">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2008 Basic Figure|pack=#18: IG-86 (Assassin Droid)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW18IG86.asp}}</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Nachkt was searching debris with his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] inside [[Golm]]'s [[Golm asteroid belt|asteroid belt]], where a [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had took place, when the ''Vulture's Claw'' was boarded by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and their [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were looking for [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Skywalker's original astromech droid who was lost during the battle. However, as R2-D2's memory banks contained secret Republic information, Nachkt, who had indeed found the droid, was planning to sell him to the Confederacy. To prevent the Jedi from finding R2-D2, the Trandoshan guided them away from the hiding place of the stolen droid, leading them to the cargo hold where his "unique" collector's items, the sentinel droids were kept.<ref name="DoDEP" />

===Activated===
{{Quote|Look at this mess you made! You owe me, Jedi!|Gha Nachkt|<ref name="DoD" />}}
While exploring the hold, Skywalker ordered R3-S6 to access the freighter's computer and find the ship's inventory manifest.<ref name="DoD" /> However, R3-S6, who was secretly a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] whose mission was to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] Skywalker,<ref name="Duel">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref> activated the two sentinel droids instead. Rising quietly, the assassin droid sneaked up on Tano, and grappled her from behind. Yelling in surprise, she alarmed Skywalker, who quickly ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Ambush on the Vulture's Claw/Legends|sliced]] the droid's right [[Limb/Legends|hand]] off, after which he [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] the droid against the other sentinel droid, and the pair violently collided with several crates. Tano ordered R3-S6 to deactivate the droids, but the pair recovered fast and pulled off the wires keeping them attached to the ship's controls. Now able to move freely, the assassins armed themselves with [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]] and opened fire on the Jedi, who deflected the shots with their lightsabers. The pair pressed the attack, jumping up onto shelves of the gargo hold, shooting relentlessly while moving around perpetually. However, Tano managed to deflect one of the shots back at the one-armed droid, who temporarily lost balance and fell down. Landing on their feet, the droid shoved a crate at the young [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]], causing her to fall backward, and turned to execute Skywalker behind his back. Before the sentinel droid could pull the trigger, Tano stood up and slashed the droid in half, after which Skywalker destroyed the other assassin droid. After the fight, the Jedi left the ship without compensating Nachkt for the destroyed droids, much to the chagrin of the scavenger.<ref name="DoD" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|These must be the unique items we were warned about. These assassins droids can be very unpredictable.''"<br />"''They're switched off. They don't look so tough to me.''"<br />"''Nothing looks tough to you. Take my word for they're deadly.|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="DoD" />}}
Produced by Holowan Mechanicals, the IG-86 sentinel droid was part of the [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] of combat droids,<ref name="TCWCG" /> belonging to the droid model considered "one of the most dangerous machine" in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CNCG">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars|text=''The Clone Wars'': Character Guide}}</ref> While Tano doubted the droid's effectiveness, Skywalker knew that in battle, the droid was deadly; Nachkt believed that even a Jedi could not beat the droid pair without lightsaber.<ref name="DoD" /> Strategic, logical and possessing an intelligent, independent mind,<ref name="CNCG" /> the droid was superior compared to the more common [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] of the [[B-series battle droid/Legends|B-series]].<ref name="Dataclip" /><ref name="CNCG" /> When faced with risk of being deactivated, the droid responded by severing connection with the controls of the freighter.<ref name="DoD" /> Cold and very unpredictable,<ref name="Dataclip" /> the droid was hostile to every living being aboard the ''Vulture's Claw'',<ref name="RSAD" /> and attacked Tano immediately upon activation. Even loss of an arm did not stop<ref name="DoD" /> the relentless sentinel droid<ref name="DoDEP" /> from attacking.<ref name="DoD" /> The assassin was extremely agile,<ref name="DoDEP" /> as evidenced when the droid jumped to the shelves and moved between them with great agility; even when the droid did lost balance, it fell in a controlled manner on their feet. While nearly invulnerable to the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] shots of an E-5 [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], the assassin was unprotected against a lightsaber, by which the droid was destroyed.<ref name="DoD" />
